original_value: A fictional add-in expansion card designed for creative workstations that need lightweight media capture acceleration, featuring a compact PCIe interface, 12GB onboard buffer, and low-profile cooling for silent desktop rigs. Optimized for ingesting camera feeds and offloading preview tasks rather than general-purpose graphics or mass storage.
